exposure: trial of labour after caesarean section
outcome: use of different labour analgesia methods
cohort: 38,596 women having a trial of labour after caesarean section as a second pregnancy, compared to a control group of 327,464 nulliparous women
finding: Women with a trial of labour after caesarean section had a generally lower rate of labour analgesia overall, but a higher rate of spinal analgesia compared to the control group.
